pages.title: Beast Lore
pages.text: $(bold)What Vaskar's Bestiary's creatures leave behind: troll hide and gall, venom glands and snake skin, chitin, scales, tusks and antlers, the antidote, and the strange plants and stones of their lairs.$(br2)$(thing)Hearth$(n), ring 4.$(br)$(thing)10 Focal Shards$(n).$(br)After Hunter.

pages.title: Task
pages.text: $(bold)$(thing)Kill 3 trolls$(n)$(br2)Pays 2 Focal Shards once. Counts only once this node is reachable.
